run_FlopCountAnalysis_total: run FlopCountAnalysis on a PyTorch model to compute total FLOPs for all modules
run_FlopCountAnalysis_by_module: run FlopCountAnalysis.by_module to get FLOP counts broken down by each submodule name
run_JitModelAnalysis_set_op_handle: run JitModelAnalysis.set_op_handle to register custom operator handles for unsupported ops like conv
test_FlopCountAnalysis_uncalled_modules: test FlopCountAnalysis.uncalled_modules to find submodules that are never invoked during the forward pass
test_FlopCountAnalysis_ancestor_mode: test FlopCountAnalysis.ancestor_mode to switch between caller and owner scope resolution for non-forward calls
